learning_objective: The learner can define evaluation criteria that specify what an application should and should not do, including out-of-scope inputs and expected responses, to avoid ambiguous scoring.

common_misconceptions.description: Believing evaluation criteria only need to describe what the application should do, ignoring out-of-scope inputs and undesired behaviors.
Assuming that vague evaluation guidelines are sufficient because scorers will interpret them consistently.
Confusing the definition of evaluation criteria with the selection of evaluation methods and data.
